name: SecureObs
summary: A production-deployed, multi-tenant security SaaS — solo-designed and built — that unifies seven open-source scanners into one triage dashboard with cross-tool deduplication, CI/CD build gating, and credential-free Infrastructure-as-Code attack-path analysis. Built on a .NET 8 Clean-Architecture backend, an Angular 21 SPA, and PostgreSQL with row-level security, all running on Azure.

stats.label: Scanners unified
stats.detail: Semgrep, Gitleaks, Trivy, Bandit, ESLint-security, OSV-Scanner, Checkov

stats.label: Shipped artifacts
stats.detail: scanner image, Terraform runner, Go canary CLI

pillars.title: Multi-scanner aggregation & build gate
pillars.description: Bundles seven scanners in one versioned image, normalizes every output into one finding shape, and merges the same issue across tools via facet-priority canonical hashing. A build gate exits non-zero on unresolved blocking findings to fail the pipeline.

pillars.title: Credential-free IaC attack-path engine
pillars.description: Statically parses Terraform with no terraform plan and no cloud credentials, builds a typed Azure resource graph, and chains misconfigurations into ranked attack paths via a pluggable rule engine — visualized in-app with Cytoscape.

pillars.title: Defense-in-depth multi-tenancy
pillars.description: Application-layer authorization combined with PostgreSQL FORCE row-level security under a restricted non-owner role, so other tenants' rows stay invisible even if an app-layer filter were ever dropped — validated by Testcontainers regression tests.

pillars.title: Zero-config managed integrations
pillars.description: GitHub App connectors, Terraform-root discovery, and auto-generated pipeline PRs run scans in ephemeral, sandboxed Azure Container Instances using short-lived tokens and auto-provisioned, project-scoped API keys — no pipeline YAML required.

pillars.title: Identity, secrets & observability
pillars.description: Entra ID OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) and SHA-256-hashed API keys, with all secrets in Azure Key Vault via Managed Identity. Instrumented with OpenTelemetry, security headers, and layered rate limiting.

pillars.title: Self-verifying release train
pillars.description: A push to the scanner image auto-bumps the version, publishes multi-tag Docker images, and updates live App Service config — backed by end-to-end canaries against OWASP WebGoat and a Go meta-verifier that asserts the ingest-and-gate contract.
